name: Countryside Marketplace
summary: Countryside Marketplace is a convenient community shopping center in Menifee featuring over 20 well-known retailers including Target, Kohl's, Lowe's, and Best Buy. Located at I-215 and Newport Road, this accessible destination combines everyday necessities with specialty shopping in a charming, old-timey atmosphere.
demographics: Countryside Marketplace serves the growing Menifee community in Southwest Riverside County, attracting primarily middle-income families and homeowners in the 30-55 age range. The trade area draws from suburban residential neighborhoods with household incomes ranging from $60,000-$100,000, featuring a mix of young families with children and established households. Shoppers typically visit for convenient one-stop shopping combining everyday necessities with specialty retail, reflecting the area's suburban lifestyle and preference for accessible, value-oriented shopping destinations.
description: Countryside Marketplace is a distinctive shopping destination located at the intersection of I-215 and Newport Road in Menifee, California, offering a unique blend of convenience and charm with its old-timey architectural feel. This well-established community center features over 20 carefully curated stores, restaurants, and specialty merchants that cater to the everyday needs of Southwest Riverside County residents. The center is anchored by major national retailers including Target, Kohl's, Lowe's, and Best Buy, complemented by popular specialty stores such as Michaels, Petco, Staples, and TJ Maxx. The shopping complex provides a comprehensive retail experience where visitors can accomplish everything from home improvement projects at Lowe's to fashion shopping at TJ Maxx, all in one convenient location. With its strategic freeway access, ample parking, and diverse tenant mix, Countryside Marketplace has established itself as a go-to shopping hub for Menifee families seeking quality retailers in a welcoming, accessible environment.
